page.overview:
What is Bone Bison?

Bone Bison were a species that was native to the planet Genna. They were preyed upon by the Kalisk.

Bone Bison grazed in Razor Grass. The species evolved armor on its hide and a beak to cover its mouth to push away the grass so it could graze. Said armor's durability made it a suitable material to craft makeshift body armor.
